About Suraksha

Suraksha is a revolutionary blood donation platform that goes beyond simple donor-receiver matching. We've integrated cutting-edge features like AI health screening, gamification, and real-time inventory tracking to make blood donation more engaging and efficient.

AI Health Assistant

Smart pre-donation screening with personalized health recommendations

Gamification System

Earn points, badges, and compete on leaderboards while saving lives

Real-time Inventory

Community Challenges

Wellness Tracking

Monitor your health and recovery after each donation

Smart Notifications

Intelligent alerts based on your preferences and location
